MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which final is written with two dots on top? (1 mark)
   A. ü
   B. u
   C. o
   D. e

2. What does 鼻子 (bízi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eye
   B. Nose
   C. Head
   D. To speak

3. What does 大家好 dàjiā hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello, everybody
   B. Goodbye
   C. Thank you
   D. Happy birthday

4. What do we call the sound at the beginning of a Mandarin syllable, such as h in hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. A stroke
   B. A tone
   C. An initial
   D. A final

5. What does 嘴巴 (zuǐba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. To wash hands
   C. To use
   D. Mouth

6. Which Chinese word means "to play"? (1 mark)
   A. 蛋糕 dàngāo
   B. 切 qiē
   C. 他们 tāmen
   D. 玩 wán

7. What does 同学们 (tóngxuémen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Classmates
   B. To be called
   C. Teacher
   D. Hello

8. What clue tells you that 咖啡 is a drink in 我喝咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. The full stop
   B. The word 我
   C. The verb 喝
   D. The verb 吃

9. What does 他们 (tāmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. They
   C. Cup
   D. We

10. What does 来 (lái) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cup
   B. To come
   C. Birthday
   D. Friend

11. Which word is pronounced xīngqīsān? (1 mark)
   A. 星期三
   B. 昨天
   C. 一
   D. 六

12. What does 弟弟 (dìdi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. Who
   C. Younger brother
   D. Younger sister

13. Fill the blank: 我____吃香蕉。 (I like to eat bananas.) (1 mark)
   A. 有
   B. 在
   C. 喜欢
   D. 不是

14. What does 水 (shuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. Vegetables
   C. Water
   D. To eat

15. Which Chinese word means "banana"? (1 mark)
   A. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   B. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   C. 菠菜 bōcài
   D. 早饭 zǎofàn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example. (3 marks)

17. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" and "This is a banana." (4 marks)

18. Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin. (5 marks)

19. Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — ü
   The lips-rounded sound ee is written ü, with two dots.

2. B — Nose
   鼻子 (bízi) means nose.

3. A — Hello, everybody
   大家 is everybody.

4. C — An initial
   The consonant sound at the start of a syllable is the initial.

5. D — Mouth
   嘴巴 (zuǐba) means mouth.

6. D — 玩 wán
   玩 (wán) means to play.

7. A — Classmates
   同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

8. C — The verb 喝
   喝 means to drink.

9. B — They
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

10. B — To come
   来 (lái) means to come.

11. A — 星期三
   星期三 is pronounced xīngqīsān and means Wednesday.

12. C — Younger brother
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

13. C — 喜欢
   喜欢 means to like.

14. C — Water
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

15. B — 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.
